Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_FixConif: Canadian Hemlock drops pine cones when chopped down, the same way Virginia Pine does. In the base game it never drops any.
Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_TreeGrow: Which trees grow over time. In the base game, wild trees stop growing well before full size. With "All trees", every tree keeps growing until it is full size. With "Base game behaviour", trees this mod has already taken over stay the size they are.
How long trees take to grow. At 1.0, a sapling reaches full size in about three in-game months. Higher is slower.

With "Catch up when you arrive", trees keep growing while you are away, so an area you come back to has grown in the meantime. With "Only while the area is loaded", trees only grow while you are nearby. This is lighter on a low end PC.
Only while the area is loaded
Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_CorrectF: Changes wild trees to species that suit the area, so a pine forest is made of pines. The base game picks species without regard to the area, so pine forests fill up with maples. A corrected tree keeps its size and its spot, and this mod handles its seasons and growth from then on. Turning this off stops new corrections but does not undo old ones.
Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_StaggerT: Trees this mod manages and bushes that grew back change on Kentucky's real timing. Leaves come out in late March, autumn colour starts in mid September, and trees are bare by early November, each one turning a little before or after its neighbours. Bushes also flower and fruit when their species does in Kentucky. Turn this off to use the base game's timing instead, which starts autumn colour in July.
Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_Vegetati: Cleared ground slowly recovers: grass first, then tall grass and ferns, then bushes, and finally trees. In the base game, cleared ground stays bare forever. "Only ground you cleared" leaves fields that were already open when the world began alone, and is lighter on a low end PC.
Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_Recovery: How fast cleared ground recovers. At 1.0, grass comes back within about a week and the first saplings appear after about a month. Higher is slower.

How thickly trees grow back. At 1.0, an area fills back in to about as dense as that kind of forest normally is. At 0, only grass and bushes grow back, with no trees. Existing trees are never thinned out.
Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_PlantedT: Whether the trees you planted affect which species grow back near them. Trees that grew back on their own always count.
Only species native to the area
Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_RequireT: You have to watch the "Home VHS: Tree Planting Guide" tape before you can plant trees. The base game never spawns this tape, so this mod adds it as a rare find in houses, sheds, garages and storage units.
